001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
005import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.INamedInstance;
006import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IResourceLocation;
007import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
008
009import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
011
012/**
013 * Represents a Metapath node item that is based on an underlying Metaschema
014 * module definition and instance.
015 *
016 * @param <D>
017 *          the Java type of the definition associated with a Metaschema module
018 * @param <I>
019 *          the Java type of the instance associated with a Metaschema module
020 */
021public interface IDefinitionNodeItem<D extends IDefinition, I extends INamedInstance> extends INodeItem {
022  /**
023   * Get the name of this node.
024   *
025   * @return the qualified name
026   */
027  @NonNull
028  default IEnhancedQName getQName() {
029    I instance = getInstance();
030    return instance == null
031        ? getDefinition().getQName()
032        : instance.getQName();
033  }
034
035  /**
036   * Get the Metaschema definition associated with this node.
037   *
038   * @return the definition
039   */
040  @NonNull
041  D getDefinition();
042
043  /**
044   * Retrieve the instance associated with this path segment.
045   *
046   * @return the instance of the segment, or {@code null} if it doesn't have one
047   */
048  I getInstance();
049
050  @Override
051  @Nullable
052  default IResourceLocation getLocation() {
053    Object value = getValue();
054    return value == null ? null : getDefinition().getLocation(value);
055  }
056}
